ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity (white) pixels on distal lobes and 35% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels concentrated in the central and leading edge regions.

A low-intensity dark region extends from the peduncle through the center to the median notch. Sub-regions of dark mottling (pixel clusters) are interspersed within the distal white zones.
